subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should OpenClaw change the terminal tool-error contract so exec-like failures with no user-visible reply emit a warning and zero-payload lastToolError turns can surface the incomplete-turn fallback?
rationale: Current source still intentionally suppresses these paths, and broad warning/fallback changes can alter channel noise and retry semantics for existing users.

options.title: Narrow Terminal-Error Repair
options.body: Change only the no-user-facing-reply cases, preserve current suppression after visible replies and recoverable errors, and add focused payload and incomplete-turn regression tests.

options.title: Treat Placeholder Fix As Sufficient
options.body: If maintainers consider exec-like warning and lastToolError fallback suppression intentional, close this issue after documenting that only the image-placeholder symptom was fixed.

options.title: Split Remaining Work
options.body: Close or narrow this broad report and track warning policy and incomplete-turn fallback as separate owner-reviewed issues.

recommendation.title: Narrow Terminal-Error Repair
recommendation.body: Change only the no-user-facing-reply cases, preserve current suppression after visible replies and recoverable errors, and add focused payload and incomplete-turn regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored recent terminal-classifier work and are the strongest history signal for choosing the terminal-state contract.
